spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Marcus at Thistle Bank speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Gareth Rahman. I’m really unhappy with the bank. The app was down when I tried to pay my electricity bill, and now I’ve been charged a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Gareth. I can see a £12 late payment fee on your account from 21 October, and your current balance is £684.20.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right. I tried several times in the app and it just wouldn’t work. It’s not good enough that I’m left paying for a problem at your end.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re frustrated, and I’m sorry for the inconvenience. I’ll take a look at what I can do to help with the bill and the fee.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’d like to know what’s going to happen about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. Before I look further, can you confirm your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, Gareth. I can see the payment was made on 22 October, a day after the due date. I’ll make a note that you couldn’t make it through the app when you first tried.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And the fee? I don’t think I should have to pay that.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t say what the outcome will be. Someone will be in touch once it’s been looked at.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: When will they be in touch?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t give you a timescale for that, I’m afraid. I’ll send the details over to our account support team today, and I’ll check back with them by Friday and call you with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just don’t want this to get lost again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s fair. I’ll make sure I follow it up myself by Friday, even if I don’t have a final answer by then.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, you were unable to pay the bill through the app, the payment went through the next day, and I’ve sent the details to account support. I’ll check with them and call you by Friday with an update. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Gareth. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll be back in touch by Friday.
